description: This file contains unit tests for the class PermissionSubjectsMap in the package org.eclipse.ditto.model.enforcers.trie. It verifies the behavior of PermissionSubjectsMap methods like addAllEntriesFrom, put, getMaxWeightForAllPermissions, getSubjectUnion, getSubjectIntersect, copy, copyWithIncrementedWeight, copyWithDecrementedWeight, removeAllEntriesFrom, addAllEntriesFrom, and equality/hashCode implementations. The tests check how PermissionSubjectsMap handles adding, copying, and querying subject-permission relations in various scenarios.

classes.name: PermissionSubjectsMapTest
classes.description: JUnit test class verifying the behavior of PermissionSubjectsMap related to permissions-to-subjects mappings in the context of enforcers.

methods.name: initConstants
methods.description: Initializes static constants used across multiple test cases such as subject IDs and permissions.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes a new PermissionSubjectsMap instance before each test.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies that PermissionSubjectsMap implements equals and hashCode correctly.

methods.name: tryToAddAllEntriesFromNull
methods.description: Tests that addAllEntriesFrom(null) throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: addAllEntriesFromEmptyMapReturnsSame
methods.description: Verifies that adding entries from an empty map returns the same instance.

methods.name: putReturnsNullForNewAssociation
methods.description: Checks that inserting a new permission returns null as previous value.

methods.name: putReturnsOldValueForNewAssociation
methods.description: Checks that inserting an existing permission returns the old value.

methods.name: addTotalRelationOfWeightZeroWorksAsExpected
methods.description: Tests adding total relation of weight zero for permissions and subjects.

methods.name: weighSubjectIds
methods.description: Helper method to create a map of subject IDs to a specific weight.

methods.name: getMaxWeightForAllPermissionsReturnsEmptyOptionalForEmptySubjectsMap

methods.name: getMaxWeightForAllPermissionsReturnsExpected
methods.description: Checks correct maximum weight retrieval across permissions.

methods.name: getMaxNonemptyWeightForAllPermissionsReturnsEmptyOptionalIfNotAllPermissionsAreRelated
methods.description: Verifies behavior when not all permissions are related.

methods.name: getMaxNonemptyWeightForAllPermissionsReturnsExpectedIfAllPermissionsAreRelated

methods.name: getSubjectUnionReturnsEmptyMapForEmptyPermissions

methods.name: getSubjectIntersectReturnsExpected

methods.name: copyOfEmptyRelationReturnsDifferentEmptyRelation

methods.name: copyReturnsExpected

methods.name: copyWithIncrementedWeightReturnsExpected
